name: cicd-integration-readiness-auditor
description: Audits whether AWS DevOps Agent is correctly and completely wired into GitHub, GitLab, and Azure DevOps for release management: connection health, repo/pipeline coverage, permission scopes, webhook wiring, and presence of the post-deployment release-testing trigger. Produces a per-repo readiness scorecard with the exact gap to close. Read-only. Recommends AWS MCP augmentation (custom source-control/CI MCP, AWS Documentation MCP) used alongside the connected associations.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on MON at 06:00 UTC
